description: We are Space Sounds, a creative and passionate team participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 in Mumbai. We are building SOUND OF TIMES, an interactive jukebox that transforms real NASA Earth and space data into music, soundscapes and immersive visual experiences. We love combining technology, science, creativity and storytelling to make scientific discoveries fun and accessible. We welcome teammates interested in coding, data science, design, animation, audio and storytelling!
